pages.title: Ice Sharp Ore
pages.text: Shards of ice frozen forever within stone, breathing frost when broken. $(thing)Ice Sharp Ore$(0) lies underground in cold biomes; mining it drops $(item)Ice Sharps$(0) (Fortune improves the yield). Any pickaxe works.

pages.title: Uses
pages.text: Ice Sharps are the basic material of the $(thing)frost line$(0): they can be crafted into $(item)Frost Ingots$(0).
